enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Dexterity +6: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Keen: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.
Ranged Alacrity 10%: Gain 10% Enhancement bonus to Ranged attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Feat: Precise Shot: While equipped this item grants the feat Precise Shot, allowing your ranged attacks to pass through other characters and monsters to strike your target.

Sneak Attack Bonus +5 : Provides a +5 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +8 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.

Deception: This weapon is hard to focus upon and thus provides a +3 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, Deception weapons have a small chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Striding +25%: This item makes you more fleet of foot, giving you a 25% Enhancement bonus your movement speed.
